name: PPSSPP

launch.notes: ES-DE: %EMULATOR_PPSSPP% %ACTION%=android.intent.action.VIEW %CATEGORY%=android.intent.category.DEFAULT %DATA%=%ROMSAF%. The activity declares a VIEW filter for file/content schemes (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hrydgard/ppsspp/master/android/AndroidManifest.xml). ES-DE's docs say to add the games folder inside PPSSPP with the Browse button so launches work (https://gitlab.com/es-de/emulationstation-de/-/raw/master/ANDROID-DEV.md).

configTarget.folderToGrant: The PPSSPP memory stick folder: the folder that CONTAINS the 'PSP' directory (PPSSPP > Settings > System > Memory stick folder). Must be in shared storage; if PPSSPP uses its private Android/data default it cannot be granted and the app falls back to 'export + manual copy'.
configTarget.notes: GetGameConfigFilePath() joins gameId + '_ppsspp.ini' inside the config search path, which is GetSysDirectory(DIRECTORY_SYSTEM) = <memstick>/PSP/SYSTEM. NOTE: the file is <DISCID>_ppsspp.ini, NOT <DISCID>_game.ini. The game ID is PARAM.SFO DISC_ID without a dash, e.g. ULUS10041 (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hrydgard/ppsspp/master/UI/GameInfoCache.cpp). Only settings flagged CfgFlag::PER_GAME are read from the game file (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hrydgard/ppsspp/master/Core/Config.cpp); missing keys keep the global value (ReadFromIniSection with applyDefaultIfMissing=false, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hrydgard/ppsspp/master/Core/ConfigSettings.cpp). GraphicsBackend is NOT per-game, so the backend is a manual global recommendation. The memstick dir is user-selectable and remembered in memstick_dir.txt (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hrydgard/ppsspp/master/UI/NativeApp.cpp). PPSSPP rewrites the whole game ini when the user edits per-game settings in its UI; merge, do not clobber.

settings.label: Rendering resolution
settings.description: Render scale relative to the PSP's 480x272. 4x = 1920x1088, matching the Thor top screen.

settings.label: MSAA
settings.description: Multisample anti-aliasing (samples = 1 << level). PPSSPP shows a warning for MSAA on tiling GPUs such as Adreno; prefer raising resolution instead.

settings.label: Frame skipping
settings.description: Skip rendering this many frames. 0 = off. Only for games that cannot hold speed.

settings.label: Auto frameskip
settings.description: Skip frames automatically when running slow.

settings.label: Skip buffer effects
settings.description: Speed hack: skips framebuffer effects. Frequently breaks graphics; per-game only.

settings.label: Skip GPU readbacks
settings.description: Avoids slow GPU-to-CPU copies. Can break effects in some games.

settings.label: Hardware transform
settings.description: Do vertex transform on the GPU. Keep on.

settings.label: On-screen counters
settings.description: Bitmask: 2 = FPS counter, 4 = speed counter, 8 = battery percent.

settings.label: CPU core
settings.description: CPU emulation method. JIT is fastest on ARM64.

settings.label: I/O timing
settings.description: Disc access timing. Some games need realistic timing to avoid hangs.

globalRecommendations.description: Vulkan backend (enum GPUBackend::VULKAN = 3). Not a per-game setting in PPSSPP: set once in PPSSPP > Settings > Graphics.
globalRecommendations.reason: Community guides for Snapdragon 8-series recommend Vulkan (search snippets only). Enum value from ConfigValues.h; CfgFlag::DEFAULT (not PER_GAME) in Config.cpp.

presets.name: Thor Balanced
presets.description: 4x resolution (1080p class), 16x AF, JIT, FPS counter on.

values.reason: Community Odin 2 guidance (retrogamecorps.com Odin starter guide, search snippet only) recommends 4x (1080p); matches the Thor 1080p top screen.

values.description: Dynarec (JIT), the default on ARM64 when JIT is allowed.
Show FPS counter for test sessions.
values.reason: Required by this app's test procedure.

presets.name: Thor Performance
presets.description: 2x resolution and skipped GPU readbacks for heavy games or longer battery life.

values.reason: Lower render cost than the 4x baseline.

values.description: Skip GPU readbacks (speed hack, can break some effects).
values.reason: Known PPSSPP speed option; value semantics from ConfigValues.h (1 = SKIP). Verify per game.
Required by this app's test procedure.

presets.name: Thor Quality
presets.description: 6x resolution supersampled onto the 1080p screen. MSAA left off (PPSSPP warns about MSAA on tiling GPUs).

values.reason: A community Odin 2 test (retroresolve.com, search snippet only) reports God of War: Ghost of Sparta holding 60 FPS even at 10x; 6x leaves margin for heavier games.
PPSSPP flags MSAA levels > 1 with a warning icon when isTilingGPU (Adreno is a tiling GPU).
Required by this app's test procedure.

manualNotes: Game-specific compatibility hacks are applied by PPSSPP's bundled compat.ini independently of these config files, so presets do not need to replicate them (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hrydgard/ppsspp/master/assets/compat.ini).
